cards.t: Kava Lend Loses $3.8 Million in Exploit
cards.b: Kava Lend suffered a hack resulting in a loss of roughly $3.8 million, sending the KAVA token down nearly 40%.

per.KAVA: Fell nearly 40% following a $3.8 million exploit where funds were bridged and sold.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Recovery plans and security patch details.

cards.t: Coinbase Suspends NEON and SYND Trading
cards.b: Coinbase announced it will suspend trading for NEON and SYND tokens on November 16.

per.NEON: Trading suspension scheduled for November 16 on Coinbase.
per.SYND: Trading suspension scheduled for November 16 on Coinbase.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact time of suspension and whether withdrawals will also be halted immediately.

cards.t: Cardano Treasury Proposal to Buy Warehouse Copper Defeated
cards.b: A $5 million ADA treasury proposal to buy warehouse copper expired after failing to secure constitutional committee votes.

per.ADA: The $5 million treasury request expired with no constitutional committee members voting yes.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST

cards.t: Luxor Suffers AI-Enabled Hashrate Hijack Attack
cards.b: Luxor experienced an AI-enabled attack over the weekend that redirected client hashrate and BTC rewards to an attacker. The vulnerability was patched within two hours, and affected customers will be reimbursed.

per.BTC: Miner rewards were temporarily redirected in an attack affecting a dozen customers.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total amount of Bitcoin redirected before the patch.
